title: 历史与文化传承词汇
goal: 辨认历史与传承词汇，准确表达建立、流传与保存的关系。

points.label: 辨认历史与传承领域词汇
选择准确传达传承关系的英文表达

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 历史与传承类材料常写四个方面：时期、交流、保护、代际传授。establish 是建立，spread 是传播，preserve 是保存。三个词表示不同的过程。

body.box:
原文：地方博物馆建立了档案，保存居民捐赠的照片。
译文：The local museum established an archive to preserve photographs donated by residents.

body.p: established an archive 表示建立档案，preserve photographs 表示保存照片。

cards.title: 词汇表：历史时期
rows: date back to an earlier period

body.box:
原文：村里建立了资料室，保存旧照片。居民向年轻人讲述照片中的故事，使地方记忆得以传承。
译文：The village established an archive room to preserve old photographs. Residents tell younger people the stories behind the photographs, passing on local memories.

body.p: established 对应建立资料室，preserve 对应保存照片。passing on 对应居民向年轻人传递记忆。保存物件与传递故事是不同动作。

groups.fill: A village history group plans to keep original photographs and record family memories. Local resi{dents} will esta{blish} an arc{hive} and pres{erve} old photo{graphs} while docum{enting} family sto{ries} for fut{ure} historical rese{arch} and educ{ation}. Volunteers will collect names and dates from the people who donate the pictures. They will store the photographs in protective folders and record the stories connected with them. Teachers can use copies in local classes, while researchers can consult the collection to learn about changes in the village over time.
notes: residents：当地居民参与建立档案。
establish：establish an archive 表示建立档案。

groups.text:
A coastal town opened a small museum to record its boat-building history. The museum collected tools and photographs from local families. It also interviewed builders, who described how they learned their skills from older workers. The recordings are kept in an archive, while selected tools are displayed in the museum.

The collection does more than show finished boats. It documents the work involved in building them and the ways knowledge moved between generations. A training programme now brings experienced builders together with apprentices. The programme teaches traditional techniques, but apprentices also learn to adapt designs for present needs. The photographs preserve evidence of earlier work; they do not replace the practical experience offered by the builders.

items.stem: 中文信息：博物馆收集了家庭提供的工具和照片。Which statement expresses this information?
options: Local families supplied tools and photographs to the museum.
Local builders supplied only photographs to the town archive.
The museum supplied families with tools and photographs.
Local families supplied tools and interview recordings to the museum.
items.why: collected tools and photographs from local families 表示家庭向博物馆提供工具和照片。

options: The finished boats made by apprentices
The recordings of interviews with builders
The tools selected for display in the museum
The designs made for present needs
items.why: The recordings are kept in an archive 说明档案保存访谈录音。

items.stem: 中文信息：造船者从年长工人那里学习技能。Which statement preserves this relationship?
options: Older workers learned boat-building skills from present apprentices.
The museum taught older workers to build boats.
Builders learned skills from workers older than themselves.
Apprentices taught builders skills from the archive.
items.why: they learned their skills from older workers 表明学习方向。

items.stem: What does adapt mean in the programme?
options: Store earlier designs in the archive
Display earlier designs in the museum
Copy every earlier design without change
Change designs to suit current needs
items.why: adapt designs for present needs 表示调整设计以适应当前需要。

items.stem: 中文信息：照片保存了早期工作的证据，实践经验来自造船者。Which statement preserves both parts?
options: Photographs document earlier work, and builders provide practical experience.
Photographs provide practical experience, and builders store earlier evidence.
Photographs replace practical experience, and builders keep the earlier evidence.
Photographs document present designs, and apprentices provide practical experience.
items.why: 末句说照片保存早期工作的证据，实践经验由造船者提供，第一项两部分都保留。

groups.fill: A weaving group plans to teach new apprentices and preserve old designs. Local wea{vers} will tran{smit} their ski{lls} and edu{cate} new appre{ntices} while prese{rving} older patt{erns}; local visi{tors} can exa{mine} and dis{cuss} these designs aloud. The group has collected examples from several families and recorded the stories behind them. Experienced makers will explain how they learned their craft and how a pattern can change over time. The records will remain available to visitors, while practical workshops will give apprentices an opportunity to learn directly from the makers.

groups.text:
A hillside village has a long tradition of making clay vessels. For many years, families used local clay to make containers for storing food and water. Experienced makers taught younger family members how to prepare the clay and shape it by hand. Their knowledge was passed on through practice rather than through written instructions.

A community centre recently began documenting this work. Residents donated old vessels for a small collection, and volunteers recorded conversations with makers. The collection preserves examples of earlier work, while the recordings explain how the vessels were made. A few damaged objects have been repaired so that visitors can study their original forms.

The centre also offers workshops led by local makers. Participants learn traditional methods and then consider how a shape might be adapted for a different use. The workshops do not claim that all families followed the same design. Instead, the makers describe differences between households and explain how they learned. In this way, the centre preserves objects and records while supporting the continued exchange of practical knowledge.

items.stem: 中文信息：年长制作者通过实践向年轻家人传授技艺。Which statement conveys this relationship?
options: Younger relatives taught older makers through written instructions.
Older makers taught younger relatives through practical work.
Visitors taught younger relatives by repairing old objects.
Volunteers taught older makers through recorded interviews.
items.why: Experienced makers taught younger family members 和 through practice 表明传授者、学习者及方式。

options: Interviews describing present workshops
Instructions written by all households
Examples of vessels made in earlier work
Clay collected for use in new vessels
items.why: The collection preserves examples of earlier work 指收藏品保存早期制作的实例。

items.stem: 中文信息：录音说明器皿的制作方法。Which statement expresses this information?
options: The recordings explain how the vessels were repaired.
The workshops explain how clay was collected.
The volunteers explain how objects were donated.
The recordings explain how the vessels were made.
items.why: the recordings explain how the vessels were made 明确说明录音的内容。

items.stem: What does adapted mean in the workshop?
options: Changed to serve a different use
Stored to preserve an earlier use
Repaired to recover the original form
Recorded to describe a family history
items.why: adapted for a different use 表示为不同用途调整形状。

items.stem: 中文信息：制作者描述了家庭之间的差异。Which statement preserves the scope of this claim?
options: Every family used an identical design for its vessels.
Makers described differences between households.
Only one family taught the same design to all visitors.
The centre replaced every household design with one form.
items.why: the makers describe differences between households 说明制作者描述家庭之间的差异。
